task.title: validate-xml script seems to validate all XML files, not just the one(s) in question
task.description: The validate-xml script ignores file arguments and always validates all XML files in the .kanban/ directory.
task.problem: When specific file paths are passed as arguments to the validate-xml script, the script ignores them and validates all XML files in the .kanban/ directory. This prevents targeted validation during development and makes the script less efficient for pre-commit hooks or iterative workflows where only specific files need checking.
task.value: Targeted validation enables faster feedback during development. When working on a specific task, only the relevant XML files should be validated, not the entire project. This improves developer experience and reduces validation time in pre-commit hooks.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the validate-xml script is invoked with file path arguments When the script runs Then only the specified files are validated And other XML files in .kanban/ are not validated
Given the validate-xml script is invoked without any arguments When the script runs Then all XML files in .kanban/tasks/ are validated And this matches the current fallback behavior
